items.title: Manuel Paul Interview, 1960-04-19
items.q: Interviewer asks about Joe Martinez; Interviewee confirms 'he had the band in charge' but provides no personal interaction or relationship details.

ctx.x: Oh, yeah. Mm-hmm. That's Louis Domaine.

That's Louis Domaine. Can you tell me, there was another fella took charge of the band, I heard once, Joe Martinez or something they talk about. Mm-hmm. Was he a director of the band for a while, too, or what happened?

Yeah, he had the band in charge, you see. Yeah, he was, Louis Domaine was directing the band. But he was supposed to be the director, but he'd put another man of the band. Sort of in charge of the band. Sort of in charge of the whole project or something. Oh, that's right. Yeah, I didn't know how that... Yeah, he had the whole project in charge. But that man would stand off and pick out what man making a bad note when they got on to this amount of men, you see. Oh, yeah.
